description: HPMS Sample Mid-America 2018 is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by Federal Highway Administration. This data represents HPMS Sample limits that correspond to the HPMS Section Data. This dataset contains expansion factors that are used to expand the attributes to State wide aggregation. More information regarding the Sample dataset is contained in the HPMS Field Manual. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 9 columns, among them NatRoute_ID, Expansion_Factor, Sample_ID, Section_Length, End_Point, Begin_Point. The portal shows 2020-12-28 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Highway Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
